communication-reach.flag: clause 13.16.31 is reached by the 2002 communication section (Annex A, the CD entry)
communication-reach.answer: Level-number does reach CD records, but through SR2, which names the CD (§2002:13.16.31.2 SR2); SR5 names only the working-storage, local-storage and linkage sections (§2002:13.16.31.2 SR5), so this rule governs no CD entry.
